name: Runtime Decoupling
summary: Runtime now uses injected ports (EventPort, StoragePort, DecisionPort, ObservabilityPort) instead of direct dependencies. SignalRuntime constructor accepts ports object for dependency inversion.

changes.description: SignalRuntime constructor now accepts SignalRuntimeOptions with injected ports
executeMutation now uses EventPort and StoragePort from @signal/ports
Removed SignalDispatcher, SignalIdempotencyStore, SignalIdempotencyRecord, SignalIdempotencyReservation (now in @signal/ports)
